summary.en: A card squashes into the line it made, landing exactly on the line the next shot starts from; in the swell profile it swells as it flattens.
summary.zh: 一张卡片压扁成它自己画出的那条线，精确落在下一个镜头起始的线上；英式线形下边压边鼓起。

fits: A card, panel or frame that hands over to a line.
notFor: Cards that must stay readable to the end; hand-offs to anything but a line.

intent.en: Turn the finished thing back into the line, so the close can grow from it.
intent.zh: 把做好的东西变回那条线，让收尾从线里长出来。

content.en: A short title on the card (≤ 4 characters).
content.zh: 卡片上一个短标题（≤ 4 字符）。

fits.zh: 要交给一条线的卡片、面板或画框。

notFor.zh: 必须读到最后的卡片；交给线以外东西的交接。

en: An eased squash that overshoots lands off the next line: use the exact landing (settle).
zh: 会过冲的缓动落不到下一条线上：用精确落定（settle）。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
